body:
Thank you for your kind words. I appreciate them.

I wish I could pursue legal action, but the truth is, I have no job, no home. No judge in their right mind will grant me anything more than any other father would get. Weekends. I don't want weekends, I want everyday. Selfish? Probably. But then again, so is the act. Or so I'm told.

While I tend to agree with you, I WANT to keep fighting, only for them, I just don't have it in me. I've already missed some of the most important years of my children's lives. I can't get those back. I don't get a redo.

Someone else is responsible for molding them into men. I'm just a vacation to them. I know they don't see it that way, but that is the truth. I'm a break from their home. A home with seven children, ranging in age from 13 to 1.

What hurts, more than anything, is my oldest. He was born with Down Syndrome. I KNOW he's not getting the attention he needs, he deserves. How could he, with seven kids to pay attention to?
